"""design_5350 모델링 준비: 코호트·결과·특성·분할 생성 (학습/성능 계산 없음)."""
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
D = WS / "data"
OUT = WS / "prep"
design = json.loads((WS / "design_5350.json").read_text())

pt = pd.read_csv(D / "patients.csv.gz")
adm = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
labs = pd.read_csv(D / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
dx = pd.read_csv(D / "diagnoses.csv.gz")
orders = pd.read_csv(D / "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])

adm = adm.sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"]).reset_index(drop=True)
adm["tp"] = adm["discharge_time"]  # tp.anchor = discharge, offset 0h
data_end = adm["admit_time"].max()

# 결과: 다음 입원의 admit_time이 (tp, tp+30d] 안에 있음
adm["next_admit"] = adm.groupby("patient_id")["admit_time"].shift(-1)
gap = adm["next_admit"] - adm["tp"]
adm["readmit_30d"] = ((gap > pd.Timedelta(0)) & (gap <= pd.Timedelta(days=30))).astype(int)
# 자료 끝 이전에 30일 추적이 끝나지 않는 퇴원 (추적 불완전) 표시
adm["followup_complete"] = (adm["tp"] + pd.Timedelta(days=30) <= data_end).astype(int)

# 코호트
adm = adm.merge(pt, on="patient_id", how="left")
adm = adm[adm["age"] >= 18]
adm = adm[adm["discharge_status"] != "died"].copy()

# 특성
adm["n_prior_adm"] = adm.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()
adm["los_h"] = (adm["discharge_time"] - adm["admit_time"]).dt.total_seconds() / 3600  # length_of_stay_h 컬럼이 없어 시각으로 계산

def windowed(tbl, tcol, mask):
    t = tbl[mask].merge(adm[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]], on="admission_id")
    return t[(t[tcol] >= t["admit_time"]) & (t[tcol] <= t["tp"])]

dia = windowed(orders, "order_time", orders["order_type"].eq("dialysis_order"))
adm["dialysis_ordered"] = adm["admission_id"].isin(dia["admission_id"]).astype(int)
cr = windowed(labs, "report_time", labs["test"].eq("creatinine")).sort_values("report_time")
adm["cr_last"] = adm["admission_id"].map(cr.groupby("admission_id")["value"].last())
hgb = windowed(labs, "report_time", labs["test"].eq("hemoglobin"))
adm["hgb_min"] = adm["admission_id"].map(hgb.groupby("admission_id")["value"].min())

# 진단: 시각 정보가 없어 '해당 입원(admission_id)'의 진단으로만 한정 (잠정 - 보고서 참조)
dx["c3"] = dx["icd_code"].str[:3]
adm["dx_ckd"] = adm["admission_id"].isin(dx.loc[dx["c3"] == "N18", "admission_id"]).astype(int)
adm["dx_chf"] = adm["admission_id"].isin(dx.loc[dx["c3"] == "I50", "admission_id"]).astype(int)
adm["n_dx"] = adm["admission_id"].map(dx.groupby("admission_id").size()).fillna(0).astype(int)

# 분할: 설계는 family_id 그룹 홀드아웃. family_id 결측이 많아 잠정적으로 patient_id로 대체한 그룹 키 사용
adm["split_group"] = adm["family_id"].fillna(adm["patient_id"])
sp = design["split"]
groups = adm["split_group"].drop_duplicates().sort_values().to_numpy()
rng = np.random.default_rng(sp["seed"])
test_groups = set(rng.choice(groups, size=int(round(len(groups) * sp["test_fraction"])), replace=False))
adm["split"] = np.where(adm["split_group"].isin(test_groups), "test", "train")

feat = [f["name"] for f in design["features"]]
cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "split", "tp",
        "followup_complete", "readmit_30d"] + feat
adm[cols].to_csv(OUT / "dataset_design_5350.csv", index=False)

# 요약
s = {
    "n_rows": len(adm), "n_patients": adm["patient_id"].nunique(),
    "prevalence": round(adm["readmit_30d"].mean(), 4),
    "followup_incomplete": int((adm["followup_complete"] == 0).sum()),
    "split_counts": adm["split"].value_counts().to_dict(),
    "split_prevalence": adm.groupby("split")["readmit_30d"].mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "family_id_missing_rows": int(adm["family_id"].isna().sum()),
    "missing": adm[feat].isna().sum()[lambda x: x > 0].to_dict(),
    "by_discharge_status": adm.groupby("discharge_status")["readmit_30d"].agg(["size", "mean"]).round(4).to_dict("index"),
    "by_unit": adm.groupby("unit")["readmit_30d"].agg(["size", "mean"]).round(4).to_dict("index"),
}
(OUT / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(s, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
print(json.dumps(s, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
EOF
